citation.authors: Fincham GW, Strauss C, Montero-Marin J, Cavanagh K

record.population: 785 adults in 12 randomised trials (various countries; ethnicity not given in the abstract)
record.design: Meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials of breathwork against non-breathwork controls, subjective stress
record.finding: Breathwork was associated with lower stress than control conditions (effect size g = -0.35, 95% CI -0.55 to -0.14). For anxiety (20 trials) g was -0.32 and for depressive symptoms (18 trials) -0.40. The authors urge caution to avoid a miscalibration between hype and evidence.
record.note: tier_variant trial-other-population. Small-to-medium effect; most studies at moderate risk of bias.
